name: Desktop Bo
provenance_note: breed_standard = CFA Cornish Rex standard (cfa.org/?p=21290); photos = Julia's reference photos of Bo; read_out = PF.Magic engine rules via petz.js kb; ours = choices made here

body.head: small egg (ball d17), Roman nose (nose low and forward of a high bridge), muzzle d5.5, cheeks d8
body.ears: tapered linez 7.8 -> 0.8 wide, tip 16 units above base (taller than the head), pink inner line shown only when facing the viewer
body.eyes: d7.2, oval-ish, slit pupil, Bo baseline lid 0.32 (indifferent half-lid) except when alert
body.neck: two linez: chest->head (coat, 8 -> 6.5) + chin->chest throat (white, 3.2 -> 7); no neck ball, so no lump
body.back: arched: back ball lifted 2.5, belly tucked up 4 (CFA 'tucked up' waistline); hips d16, chest d17, back d12, belly d10, topline linez 13 -> 10.5 -> 12.5
body.legs: stands high: chest y30, hips y31; front IK 12+12 from shoulder at chest-1.8 (near-straight columns); hind IK thigh 7.5 + shank 10.5 (short thigh, long shank: knee rides up by the belly, long white lower leg), hock 11 above paw; thigh ball 9.5, thigh linez 6.5->3.6, knee 4.2
body.tail: 15 joints, 14 linez tapering 3.5 -> 1.2, dark brown; wrap mode (sit/loaf/crescent): drop to floor, sideways turn wide of the haunch, run forward along the flank, tip curls in over the paws, always on the viewer's side
body.coat: marcel waves: staggered 2px dash rows every 3rd ball row, one shade darker, on coat/back/limb/belly/chest slots
body.outline: no per-ball rims; one 1px silhouette outline from an offscreen alpha pass
body.roll: roll about the spine with the low side rested on the ground; the ground-rest is weighted by min(1, |roll|/35) and lerped pose values snap exactly to target within 0.01, so a cat that gets up from a flop/lounge/tussle is never left sunk into the floor

walk.swing_path: eased with ~6% overreach then set down
walk.flex: front wrist leads and paw trails curled through 62% of swing, extends to reach; hind hock folds; heel peels in last 18% of stance
walk.track: narrow runway: front paws z +-2.7, hind +-3.1
walk.girdles: shoulder/haunch over the planted leg rises 1.3/0.8 (blades roll)
walk.spine: hip z sway 0.9, chest -0.7, back undulates 0.5
walk.head: slightly low and level, counter-bobs, yaw sways 2.5 deg, leads turns by up to 30 deg

gait.speed: eased toward target (walk 0.07/frame, run 0.16), slows into arrival (0.3 + 0.06*distance), amble +-14% on a slow sine; stride length scales with speed (0.35..1.1) so feet never skate
gait.turning: inside her turning circle she pivots on the spot with short shuffling steps (fix for circling); stuck counter 50 frames
gait.run: rotary gallop LF 0, RF .1, LH .5, RH .6, spine flex 3.5
gait.rule: any step is taken on long legs: gait on a low base pose (hipY < 29) switches the base to stand; stalking steps (creep gait, crouch or slink anim) use the slink pose
gait.slink: stalk pose: hips 27.5, chest 25, head 5 forward / 7 down, ears forward, tail low; crouch only for the last wiggle before a pounce

tail_dynamics.model: per-segment damped spring on elevation and side angle; k = 0.30 at base -> 0.10 at tip, damping 0.74; body turns push the tail opposite (dTheta * i/n * 0.9)

lash.when: after a poke or being scruffed, belly trap

moods.flick: tip-only pulse during naps and when tapped asleep

styles.baguette: long low loaf: hips -17, chest 13, legs tucked, head forward and down, tail straight back
styles.crescent: curled round: hips and chest close, back domed 8, head tucked under and turned, tail wrapped
styles.lounge: roll 38, near foreleg flat forward, hind leg flat behind (the leg out), upper shoulder/haunch sunk into the body
styles.sphinx: loaf with forearms flat on the ground, paws out front, head up, eyes half closed
styles.loaf: compact: forelegs hidden under the chest (elbows in), only paw tips showing, hind legs tucked
styles.flop: on her side (roll 80 about the spine), legs out, ears relaxed back, waist balls fattened so no dog-bone silhouette; preferred in sunbeams

naps.sequence: walk to spot (sunbeam or pod sometimes) -> turn round once -> settle (loaf) -> style -> may shift style every 20-40s -> wake: stretch, yawn
naps.drive: energy need: drops while awake (scaled by sleepiness), restores while napping; nap weight = ((100-energy)/100)^1.6 * sleepy * 0.7

dangle.shape: curled (backLift 6.5, head down -11, pitch -30), near foreleg ik to [27,-9,3.2]: poured out long and hanging below the bed surface; hind legs tucked; tail wrapped
dangle.where: beds with an edge: pillow, ledge, daybed/seat, adk, cubby, ctable, stoop, tire, chairs; weighted up for Bo

bunny.coat: all white, gold/yellow eyes, pink ears/nose
bunny.shape: head 1.06, ears 1.06 tall/.95 wide, limbs .82, body .88, tail .85
bunny.note: older and tinier than Bo but the one who wallops her

items.pod: placeable egg bed; sleepy cats walk over, turn, hop in and nap clipped to the opening; one occupant
items.grass: cat grass tray; 14 servings, nibbled blades get short, regrows 1 per ~36s; grazing = head down, sideways chew
items.catnip: potted catnip; two nibbles -> ~14s zoomies -> flop nap; 200s cooldown
items.spider: spider plant; bat the leaves, then nibble
items.yarn: read_out ball physics (1/40 friction, edge bounce), chased with 4-frame lead
items.treat: carry to make them beg, click to drop
items.sun: placeable sunbeam: two nap slots, the comfort zone
items.chair: armchair (first of the furniture line): perch and nap on the seat
items.drop_in_bed: pick a cat up and let go over a free pod/chair: a pulsing ring marks it; she sits, loafs, then curls up (short nap unless tired)

ui.mac: menu-bar Bo icon -> toy-box panel (portrait, mood, belly/energy/love meters, where she lives, put-out grid, rexes, size, sound, open at login, quit); habitat window with its own title bar and Toy box button
ui.placement: pick a tile, the item follows the cursor, click to put it down; drag to move; x to put away

stretch.front: downward dog: forearms flat, paws 38 forward, chest y8, hips y28.5, spine dipped
stretch.back: weight forward, hind leg extended to x -36 with hock folded

attention.model: per stimulus: noticed after a personal latency (Bo 22-70 frames), interest rises with salience x curiosity x play mood x tempo, falls with aloofness, grumpiness, boredom and fatigue, plus a slow ebb; she commits only above her own threshold
attention.modes: watch / stalk / chase / swat / groom, re-picked every 35-110 frames weighted by interest, aloofness, energy, distance and whether a buddy is already on it
attention.boredom: engaging one toy accrues boredom (0.0011/frame x aloofness); recovers slowly when apart
attention.energy: play drains energy; below 15 she drops out
attention.still_toys: a toy lying still has 35% of the distance salience, so a parked felt mouse doesn't trigger endless stalking

social.relationship: bond = 0.72 + 0.18 sin(slow phase) - tension/4 (love/hate/love); tension rises when crowding the same prey, cools in shared sunshine
social.comfort_zone: when one sleeps in a sunbeam the other is strongly pulled (+16 x bond to nap weight, 14 x bond to take the slot beside her, mirroring her style); neither wakes while the other sleeps there

brawl.source: Julia: Bunny body-slammed Bo; chase-and-brawl fests, mostly napping together otherwise
brawl.start: weight = play x energy/70 x sass/50 x bond x 6 (play, so bond not tension); target accepts with p = play*.6 + bond*.35 + sass/250 +-energy

phases.box: both rear on hind legs trading cuffs, 40-80 frames
phases.slam: the feistier one hops and lands on the other, who goes over
phases.roll: bottom cat on her back kicking (roll 128), top cat pins from behind and nips the scruff, 45-90 frames
phases.after: 55% loser flees + winner chases, 20% revenge chase, 25% both groom like nothing happened; 1-3 rounds

brawl.effects: bond +0.04, tension -0.05, energy -8, play mood x0.6

sound.voice: sawtooth softened by a 2.4k low-pass + breath noise into 3 parallel formant filters gliding between cat-scale vowels (m 420/1500, i 720/2500, a 1150/1900, o 820/1350); master low-pass 5.2k + compressor, gain .32
sound.meow: mi-a-ow, f0 560 x pitch, Bo 0.86 and raspier
sound.trill: mrrp: low (330 x pitch), rolled 26Hz flutter, rising
sound.purr: lowpassed noise pulsed ~25Hz with a slow breath cycle

modes.stalk: slink on long legs, crouch only for the final wiggle
modes.chase: leads the target 4 frames; random freeze-and-stare (16-44f); skids 10f when the target reverses under speed
modes.swat: alternating paws, 1-in-4 one-two double tap, per-cat cadence 12-22f (slower for aloof), Bo half-amplitude lazy taps; paw hooks inward
modes.kick: flop onto side hugging a ball toy, hind feet rake it, then fling it
modes.toss: scoop the toy into the air (z, gravity 0.32, bounce 0.38), rear up after it, bat it on the way down
modes.crab: arched sideways hop past the prey, then a lunge
modes.wall: laser above the floor line: trot under it, rear, spring (hop height scales with dot height), paw at it

pounces.mouse: 19f, 27 high, 70% travel, lands in pin pose holding the toy

room.source: ours, after RollerCoaster Tycoon-era sprite craft (shade ramps + ordered dither, single light source, dense specific props, small ambient animation)
layers: bg: dithered sage wall lit from the window, stencil sprigs, crown + picture rail, wainscot panels, chair rail, baseboard; perspective plank floor with per-plank tone, grain, knots, bevels; kilim rug; paned sunbeam; walnut bookcase with books, lamp, pampas, photo; two framed prints; wall clock
view: sky by real time of day (day/dawn/dusk/night ramps, stars, lit windows at night), far skyline, brick and limestone fronts, water tower, treetops, hanging bird feeder
pigeon (visits the feeder by day; cats chatter at it)
frame: trim, mullions, transom, glare, sill + succulent, curtain rod
plants: hanging pothos, bird of paradise, philodendron on iron stand

places.rule: each place keeps its own item set (World.sets); habitat window shows room or yard; roam is desk

surfaces.what: raised spots small things can sit on: room sill, bookTop, shelf1, shelf2, ctable; yard shelfTop, shelfMid, stand, landing
surfaces.item_fields: surf (key), su (0..1 along it), lift (px above its sort ground)
surfaces.eligible: non-bed, non-tool, non-snack, not the bowl
surfaces.knock_off: a cat in a bed with a surface (ledge->sill, ctable, stoop->landing, potTop->shelfTop) glances at you, swats 3-4 times, the thing falls with gravity and lands with a thunk

room: cubby (felt cube, clip = hole ellipse, dangle leg drawn over the lip)
yard: stoop (cats enter through the studio doors onto it)

garden.growth: g seconds += 1 + 1.6*water every 30 frames; stages at 25 / 110 / 260; offline growth at 0.6x capped 2 h
garden.tools: seed packets, watering can (startles cats), trowel

yard.layers: sky -> woods (3 hazed trunk/foliage layers, litter band) -> studio (clapboard 6px laps, white trim, windows reflect the woods, French doors drawn live) -> ground (lawn | flagstone Worley slabs with moss joints) -> plots -> plant-care corner -> deck/steps -> dapple (shade with punched flecks, double-drawn shimmer) -> sun pools -> [props: trunk, stone bunny; items; cats] -> life (leaves, butterflies, squirrel, fireflies) -> canopy -> phase tint
yard.life: 2 butterflies by day (stimuli when low), leaves fall and lie, squirrel runs down the tree to the lawn and back (birdSpot for chatter), fireflies at night

chairs.poppy: tall (seat 27, arms 39.5, back 68 units), butter-cream ramp, coral 5-petal poppies on sage vines in a jittered repeat, T-cushion, welted base, skirt with kick pleats
chairs.dfly: Louis XV bergere: cabriole legs, carved apron with a shell, serpentine top rail with a carved flower, padded arm manchettes, blue-gray checked damask with staggered gold dragonflies, twisted blue/gold cord
